name: nanar-repo
description: Repository tooling for Nanar: git hooks, privacy and commit checks, formatting.

scripts.check: npm run check:private && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && uv run ruff check && uv run ruff format --check && uv run mypy --platform win32 && uv run mypy --platform linux && uv run pytest -q
